_why: Real released versions for the packages this loop seeds, so a keyless gate can tell a concrete release from a fabricated one. PROMPT.md asks for 'a concrete, currently-real release version'; verifying that against an index needs the network, which this loop refuses by design. Shipping the reference data instead is the pattern citation-existence-check already uses with known_reporter.json.
_scope: A FLOOR, not an index. A package listed here must pin a version listed here. A package absent from this file is not checked -- the file makes a positive claim about what exists, never a negative one about what does not, so it cannot reject a real release it has simply never heard of.
_staleness: Adding a newly-released version is a one-line edit and the gate stays keyless. A production pinning loop that must track releases live composes this format gate with a network-backed one; see README.md.
